title: Rumi on Love: Flying Toward the Sky
subtitle: Eight Persian Sufi poems with English translation
yt_title: Rumi on Love | 8 Persian Sufi Poems with English Translation
intro: For Rumi, love is not one feeling among many. It is the force that moves everything.
It heals, it burns, it lifts the body of earth toward the sky.
Here are eight passages from his Masnavi and his Divan-e Shams about love.

poems.name: Flying Toward the Sky

lines.fa: عشق است بر آسمان پریدن
lines.en: Love is flying toward the sky,

lines.fa: صد پرده به هر نفس دریدن
lines.en: tearing a hundred veils with every breath.

lines.fa: گفتم که دلا مبارکت باد
lines.en: I said: O heart, may it be blessed for you,

lines.fa: در حلقه عاشقان رسیدن
lines.en: to have reached the circle of lovers.

tafsir: Rumi begins with a definition, and it is not a gentle one.
Love is flight. And every breath tears another veil between us and what is real.
Then he turns to his own heart and congratulates it, as if it had arrived home.
To join the circle of lovers, for him, is the best news a heart can receive.

poems.name: Love the Healer

lines.fa: شاد باش ای عشق خوش‌سودای ما
lines.en: Be joyful, O Love, our sweet madness,

lines.fa: ای طبیب جمله علت‌های ما
lines.en: O physician of all our ills,

lines.fa: ای دوای نخوت و ناموس ما
lines.en: O cure for our pride and our vanity,

lines.fa: ای تو افلاطون و جالینوس ما
lines.en: you are our Plato and our Galen.

tafsir: These lines come from the opening song of the Masnavi.
Plato stands for wisdom, and Galen was the great physician of the ancient world.
Rumi says love is both: the philosopher and the doctor.
And the illness it treats first is pride. Love is the one medicine for the swollen self.

poems.name: The Mountain Danced

lines.fa: جسم خاک از عشق بر افلاک شد
lines.en: Through love, this body of earth rose to the heavens;

lines.fa: کوه در رقص آمد و چالاک شد
lines.en: the mountain began to dance and grew light.

tafsir: The mountain here is Mount Sinai, where Moses asked to see God.
In the Quran, the mountain crumbles when God's light touches it.
Rumi reads that moment as a dance.
Even something as heavy as a mountain becomes light when love reaches it.

poems.name: The Call of Love

lines.fa: هر نفس آواز عشق می‌رسد از چپ و راست
lines.en: With every breath, the voice of love comes from left and right.

lines.fa: ما به فلک می‌رویم عزم تماشا که راست
lines.en: We are going to the sky. Who wants to come and see?

tafsir: This is one of Rumi's most joyful openings.
Love is not far away. Its voice arrives from every side, all the time.
And the answer is an invitation, almost playful: we are leaving for the sky. Who is coming?
Love, for Rumi, always wants company on the road.

poems.name: The King of Love

lines.fa: هوسی است در سر من که سر بشر ندارم
lines.en: There is a longing in my head beyond anything human;

lines.fa: من از این هوس چنانم که ز خود خبر ندارم
lines.en: it has carried me so far that I know nothing of myself.

lines.fa: دو هزار ملک بخشد شه عشق هر زمانی
lines.en: The king of love gives away two thousand kingdoms every moment;

lines.fa: من از او به جز جمالش طمعی دگر ندارم
lines.en: from him I want nothing but his beauty.

tafsir: Love here is a king who can give anything at all.
Two thousand kingdoms, every moment.
And the lover refuses all of it. He wants only to see the king's face.
This is the difference between loving someone and loving what they can give you.

poems.name: Thorn and Rose

lines.fa: چو گلزار تو را دیدم چو خار و گل بروییدم
lines.en: When I saw your rose garden, I grew up like thorn and rose together;

lines.fa: چو خارم سوخت در عشقت گلم بر تو نثار آمد
lines.en: when my thorn burned in your love, my rose was scattered at your feet.

tafsir: We are all a mixture of thorn and rose.
Rumi does not pretend otherwise.
But in love the thorn burns away, and what is left, the rose, is offered as a gift.
Love does not ask us to be perfect first. It burns what is sharp and keeps what is sweet.

poems.name: Where Is Love's Shop?

lines.fa: طبیب درد بی‌درمان کدام است
lines.en: Who is the physician for the pain that has no cure?

lines.fa: رفیق راه بی‌پایان کدام است
lines.en: Who is the companion on the road that has no end?

lines.fa: یکی جزو جهان خود بی‌مرض نیست
lines.en: Not one part of the world is free of sickness;

lines.fa: طبیب عشق را دکان کدام است
lines.en: so where is the shop of Love, the physician?

tafsir: Rumi asks honest questions here.
Some pain has no cure, and some roads have no end.
Everything in the world is a little wounded.
So he goes looking for love's shop, as a sick man looks for a doctor's door. The search itself is a kind of hope.

poems.name: Made of Love's Wine

lines.fa: منم مستی و اصل من می عشق
lines.en: I am drunkenness, and my origin is the wine of love;

lines.fa: بگو از می به جز مستی چه آید
lines.en: tell me, what can come from wine but drunkenness?

tafsir: In Sufi poetry, wine is the image of love that overwhelms the self.
Rumi says he was made from that wine.
So what else could he be, but intoxicated by it?
It is his way of saying: love is not something I do. It is what I am made of.
